# foundry_evaluation_rule (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["evaluations"]` on the provider. Preview features may change their inputs, outputs, or behavior in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up a Foundry evaluation rule by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluations are a preview feature; opt in on the provider block:
# provider "foundry" {
#   enable_preview = ["evaluations"]
# }

data "foundry_evaluation_rule" "continuous_support_eval" {
  id = "support-response-completed"
}

output "eval_id" {
  value = data.foundry_evaluation_rule.continuous_support_eval.eval_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the evaluation rule.

### Read-Only

- `agent_name` (String) Name of the Foundry agent this rule is scoped to.
- `description` (String) Description of the evaluation rule.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the evaluation rule.
- `eval_id` (String) ID of the evaluation run when the rule triggers.
- `event_type` (String) Event that triggers the rule.
